notes.title: City Builder Fest Demo Released!
notes.content:
Features:

 BROTHELS and TAVERNS introduce our new Entertainment mechanic with a new mission - use these structures to satisfy Heads of Households' new need for Entertainment as a housing upgrade requirement, and keep the Tavern stocked with Wine and Mutton to satisfy visitors' existing hunger and thirst needs as well.
 MORE HOUSING, QUICKER - a new house and two new apartments extend our housing upgrade chain to nine levels, with tuned upgrade requirements so each level only requires one or two new things
 BUTCHER SHOP - assign Butchers to turn Mutton into Chops as a luxury food, now required for Easter Service in larger settlements
 Boosted early game immigration rates to improve opening pace
 Color-coded residents' needs text based on current satisfaction level (green/yellow/red) to make it much easier to tell what you still need to achieve the next level of housing
 More granular city grading (X+/X- grades) and a wider range of mapped values makes it easier to track changes in grades
 Reduced derelict houses' undesirability radius so initial housing upgrades can occur without first having to clean up basically the entire derelict town
 Removed 20-tile radius limit on pegfolk searching for goods, they now search the entire map
 Tuned Easter Service grading for fairness, placing more emphasis on the most recent years
 Tuned Market/Churches/Santa Maria max workers, Market max resources
 Refreshed per-profession job wheel colors for better differentiation
 New dynamic SFX for assign/release worker UI
 Female immigrants use different 3D model
 Hover hints on all resource icons, regardless of where they appear in the UI


Bugs Fixed:

 Artists wouldn't build statues until their workshop was completely full of supplies
 Statues installed in plazas were not rendered after a game was saved and loaded
 Pausing then unpausing while in a faster game speed reset the game speed back to 1x
 Loading a saved game would trigger an extra immigrant spawn event
 Plazas' and churches' desirability ranges would shrink instead of grow when a statue was installed after saving and loading a game
 Baby sheep slid along the ground when first spawned (also tuned sheep movement to be less spastic / more lumbering)
 Emporium "Awaiting Pickup" resource totals became inaccurate when pegfolk set out to collect imported resources
 A whole bunch of game text was inaccurate/misleading/omitted information

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Released!
notes.content:
Features:

 First ever demo time limit boost, from 90 to 120 minutes (!)
 Density! In the biggest ever change to our core gameplay loop, houses now require surrounding density in order to upgrade, leading to much more strategic and compelling gameplay and a natural 'dense core, sparse outskirts' gradient of housing types in your city
 New or refreshed UI for desirability and job assignments panels, grand objectives overlay, resource bar, help text, progress bars, select cursor, and job wheels
 New logic determining the arrival of Masters, to better ensure you can put their abilities to immediate use
 New custom mouse cursors for job assignments and master movement
 Refined toolhints to better help new players

Bugs Fixed:

 Olive press worker animation clipped through model
 Well didn't show scaffolding effect on upgrading

notes.title: Demo v2.8.4 Update
notes.content:
Features:

 Rats scamper around debris, derelict structures, and mass graves
 Flocks of birds occasionally fly high over your town
 Additional custom mouse cursors for copy/demolish tools
 New SFX for dismantling debris/derelict structures/derelict roads
 'Message from the Developers' appears on quit/demo completion

Bugs Fixed:

 Axe 3D icon appeared too low when prioritizing forests for harvesting
 Fly 2D icon didn't appear in info panel when a rot-affected structure was selected
 Demolish cursor showed red when hovering on derelict structures

notes.title: Demo v2.8.2 Update
notes.content:
Features:

 Add visual effect to building upgrade
 Additional audio for upgrades, butcher, tailor, and weaver.
 New custom mouse cursor

Bugs Fixed:

 Houses would not upgrade right away if able to completely fill with satisfied residents immediately upon construction
 Satisfied house occupants didn't trigger house upgrades properly after loading a saved game
 Season wheel tooltip believed only in eternal summer
 Incorrect escape key behavior for canceling tool state
 Incorrect text color on progress bars was hard to read
 Chops icon not displayed in Emporium

notes.title: Demo v2.8.1 Update
notes.content:
Features:

 Adds the Weavers' Workshop, which turns wool from a pasture into fabric.

Bugs Fixed:

 It wasn't possible to build the Tailor because it was locked behind the Weaver which couldn't be unlocked yet.

notes.title: Demo v2.7.9 Update
notes.content:
Features:

 Simplified town ratings UI, which now drives more immigration
 Improved right click behavior
 Reduced merchant employee max from 8 to 4

Bugs Fixed:

 Bulldozing debris construction sites would crash the game
 Luxurious Urban Apartment was missing its tax rate

notes.title: Demo v2.7.8 Update
notes.content:
Features:

 Tailor Shop is upgradeable
 Escape key can be used to close various on-screen menus, exit Desirability/Job Assignment modes, and enter Pause Menu

Bugs Fixed:

 Manually upgrading a structure would sometimes fail/lock up game UI despite consuming the required resources
 Animal skull icon was appearing over the Pasture when an animal was slaughtered for meat

notes.title: Demo v2.7.6 is now live!
notes.content:
Major Features:

 Game opens with plague aftermath: rotting corpses, debris, derelict buildings and roads that can be restored in place or demolished for resources.
 Relics: discover sacred artifacts that grant powerful blessings when enshrined in a church.
 Masters: recruit exceptional individuals with unique abilities that activate when assigned to specific locations in your city.
 Wonders: construct iconic landmarks that bestow extraordinary, city-wide benefits.
 Historipedia: a new UI with ‘collectable’ cards to track your progress in unlocking Relics, Masters, Artworks, and Wonders.
 Drought: periodic dry conditions leave the landscape cracked and dusty, slowing crop growth and reducing harvests.
 Needs-based housing upgrades: homes now upgrade when all of their residents’ needs are satisfied, with increasingly diverse and complex requirements as they level up.
 Death management: citizens leave a corpse when they die, which must be buried or it will rot, impacting pathfinding and employment.
 More buildings and upgrades! Construct the new Pasture, Tailor, Graveyard, and Mass Grave, spend resources to enhance the look and efficiency of the Bakery, Winery, Olive Press, and Mine, and strive to reach a new level of Urban Apartment for your residents.
 Revamped pacing for less hectic and more thoughtful gameplay: years progress more slowly, immigration pauses when you run out of available housing, and crop growth is more closely tied to the progression of seasons.
